name: Arpana
tagline: An Offering Through Dance · A Journey Through the Divine Symphony of Avatars
description: Arpana is the Annual Day celebration of Nrutyapuri Dance Academy — a humble offering of devotion, dedication and artistic excellence by our students. This year's presentation celebrates the Chronicles of Dharma: the ten divine incarnations of Lord Vishnu, brought to life through expressive abhinaya, intricate footwork and vibrant Odissi choreography. More than a recital, Arpana is an offering at the feet of the Divine and a tribute to our revered Guru — an evening where mythology meets movement and every performance becomes an offering of the heart.
highlights: Chronicles of Dharma — the ten avatars of Lord Vishnu in Odissi
A tribute to our Guru by the students of Nrutyapuri
An evening where mythology meets movement
